researchReview.scope: Full Week 2 Sunday pregame catch-up for all 15 games still awaiting kickoff, covering every material development after the verified Saturday Delta endpoint through this run. Quarterback status, final injury designations, roster elevations, replacement roles, Monday status changes and material weather were revalidated without viewing market information.

signConvention.spreadHome: Negative = home favorite; positive = home underdog.
signConvention.gap: Pinnacle home spread minus Graham home fair. Positive = Graham stronger on home; negative = Graham stronger on away.
signConvention.moneylinePair: Displayed as away / home American prices.
